newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM TO CUT COMBITRANS STAKE TO 39 PCT.
newsitem.headline: UPM TO CUT COMBITRANS STAKE TO 39 PCT.

text.p: UPM-Kymmene Oy will reduce its majority holding in transport company Combitrans Oy, which will become a new company owned 39 percent by UPM-Kymmene, 10 percent by a unit of Partek Oy Ab and 51 percent by Transpoint Oy, the new firms' owners said on Monday in a joint statement.
No value was given for the ownership reshuffle.
Before the deal, UPM-Kymmene's stake in Combitrans was 90 percent, the companies said.
"Combitrans' business idea will remain unchanged," the companies said.
"Combitrans Oy's domestic net sales are about 260 million markka, and its transport volume about 4.3 million tonnes per year," they said.
The arrangements related to the deal were scheduled to be completed by July 1 when the transfer would take place, the companies said.
